infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Caremango records where you check in and out of a visit, so your agency can evidence that care was delivered. Your location is only read while the app is open.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Take photos as part of a visit record or an incident report.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Record a spoken care note instead of typing it.
infoPlist.NSFaceIDUsageDescription: Unlock Caremango without typing your password.

plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: Caremango records where you check in and out of a visit.

plugins.faceIDPermission: Unlock Caremango without typing your password.

plugins.photosPermission: Caremango attaches photos to a visit record — a wound, a meal, or a maintenance issue.
plugins.cameraPermission: Take photos as part of a visit record or an incident report.
